# RX flexible coupling: installation and alignment
Permissible misalignment for RX couplings up to size 90:
| Misalignment | Limit |
|---|---|
| Parallel offset | 0.05 mm |
| Angular | 0.05 mm per 100 mm |
| Axial gap | 3 mm ± 0.5 mm |
RX coupling sizes
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 50 mm | 450 N·m | PN-5120-A |
| 70 | 70 mm | 1,250 N·m | PN-5170-A |
| 110 | 110 mm | 5,200 N·m | PN-5210-A |
For couplings above size 90, halve the permissible misalignment in the table above.
